clues.body: My clients were just working through the holidays. They walked into what they thought was an empty house and got a blowtorch, a tarantula and a paint can to the face. Who is the real victim here?
Two burglars who call themselves the Wet Bandits.
They spent weeks casing every house on the street and then targeted the one where an eight-year-old boy had been left alone.
Christmas family comedy, 1990
A boy accidentally left behind when his family flies to Paris for Christmas defends his house from two burglars.
My client was a struggling writer who took a winter job to support his family and suffered a severe case of cabin fever.
A caretaker and would-be novelist who keeps typing the same sentence.
He chased his wife and young son through a snowed-in hotel with an axe and broke down a bathroom door to reach them.
Psychological horror, 1980
A family spends the winter as caretakers of an isolated mountain hotel, where the father slowly loses his mind.
My client's sister was crushed by a falling house, and the girl responsible walked off wearing the family's shoes. She only wanted them back.
A green-skinned witch who rules the western lands and commands an army of flying monkeys.
She set a scarecrow on fire, kidnapped a young girl and her dog, and threatened the lives of all her friends.
Fantasy musical, 1939
A Kansas farm girl swept away by a tornado must reach a great wizard to find her way home.
My client only ever wanted his father's love and approval. He was crowned emperor in a moment of grief.
The jealous son of a Roman emperor who fights in the arena himself.
He smothered his own father, ordered a loyal general executed and had the general's wife and son killed.
Historical epic, 2000
A betrayed Roman general is sold into slavery and fights as a gladiator to take revenge on the emperor.

title: Star Wars
aliases: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope

clues.body: My client was enforcing the law against a terrorist group that stole classified military plans. He breathes with difficulty and cannot be expected to have patience.
A masked commander in black armor who serves the Empire.
He choked an officer with his mind for a sarcastic remark and stood by while a whole planet was destroyed.
Space fantasy adventure, 1977
A farm boy joins a rebellion, an old knight and a smuggler to rescue a princess and destroy a planet-killing space station.
My client is the most admired man in town. He only tried to protect the village from a dangerous monster.
A vain hunter who uses antlers in all of his decorating.
He tried to have a woman's father locked in an asylum to force her to marry him, then led a mob to a castle and stabbed its master.
Animated musical, 1991
A bookish young woman held in a castle by a cursed prince learns to see past his appearance.
My client is a machine following his programming. You cannot put a computer program on trial.
A cyborg assassin sent back in time from the year 2029.
He worked through the phone book killing every woman with the same name, then walked into a police station and killed nearly everyone inside.
Science fiction action, 1984
A Los Angeles waitress is hunted by a killer robot from the future and protected by a soldier sent back to save her.
My client is a celebrated explorer who was wrongly called a fraud and has spent his life trying to clear his name.
A famous adventurer living in South America with an airship and a pack of talking dogs.
He set his dogs on an old man and a boy, set a house on fire and tried to cage a rare bird to take home as a trophy.
Animated adventure, 2009
An elderly widower ties balloons to his house to fly to South America and finds a young scout stowed away on his porch.
My client is a businessman with a financial grievance against a corporation. He even let most of the hostages live.
A polished German criminal who poses as a terrorist leader to pull off a $640 million heist.
He executed the company's boss in cold blood and planned to blow up the roof with every hostage on it.
Christmas action thriller, 1988
An off-duty New York cop takes on a gang of thieves who seize a Los Angeles skyscraper during a Christmas party.
My client was an overworked, underpaid computer contractor who just needed a little extra money.
A sloppy programmer who sells dinosaur embryos to a rival company.
He shut down every security fence on the island during a storm, setting the predators loose on the guests.
Science fiction adventure, 1993
A group of experts touring an island theme park of cloned dinosaurs are stranded when the power fails.
My client was simply feeding in his natural habitat when tourists kept splashing around in his dinner.
A great white shark that will not leave the waters off a summer resort island.
He attacked swimmers on a holiday weekend and sank the boat of the men hunting him.
Summer thriller, 1975
A police chief, a marine scientist and a fisherman hunt a giant shark terrorizing a beach town.
My client served the Sultan loyally for years as his royal adviser. He simply wanted a promotion.
A royal vizier with a snake-headed staff and a sarcastic parrot.
He hypnotized the Sultan, left a young man to die in a cave and later used a genie's wishes to take over the kingdom.
Animated musical, 1992
A street boy finds a magic lamp and uses the genie inside to pose as a prince and win a princess.
My client is a devoted son who runs a quiet family motel and simply does what Mother tells him.
A shy young motel owner who stuffs birds as a hobby.
A guest checked into Cabin 1 one rainy night and never checked out.
Horror thriller, 1960
A secretary who stole $40,000 stops at a remote motel run by a young man and his controlling mother.
My client simply has high standards. She runs the most important magazine in fashion, and excellence takes discipline.
The ice-cold editor-in-chief of a powerful fashion magazine.
She sent her assistant out in a hurricane to find a flight, demanded an unpublished Harry Potter manuscript and treated her staff as disposable.
Workplace comedy, 2006
An aspiring journalist takes a job as assistant to a demanding fashion editor in New York.

title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs

clues.body: My client asked an honest question of her mirror and was simply told she had been replaced. Wanting to stay the best is not a crime.
A vain queen who disguises herself as an old peddler woman.
She ordered a huntsman to bring back her stepdaughter's heart, and when that failed she poisoned the girl with an apple.
Animated fairy tale musical, 1937
A princess hides from her jealous stepmother in a forest cottage with seven miners.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
aliases: The Curse of the Black Pearl

clues.body: My client lives under a terrible curse. He only wants to return some gold so he can taste food and feel the wind again.
A cursed pirate captain who turns into a skeleton in the moonlight and has a pet monkey.
He led a mutiny, left his own captain marooned on an island, raided a port town and kidnapped the governor's daughter.
Swashbuckling fantasy adventure, 2003
A blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate to rescue the governor's daughter from a crew of undead pirates.
My client was passed over for the throne his whole life. He simply stepped up to lead when the kingdom suddenly needed a ruler.
A scheming younger brother with a scar over one eye, backed by a pack of hyenas.
He pushed his own brother off a cliff into a stampede, then told his grieving nephew it was the boy's fault and sent him into exile.
Animated musical, 1994
A young lion prince flees his kingdom after his father's death and must return to reclaim his place as king.
My client cleaned up his kingdom and simply wanted to find a suitable queen.
A very short ruler of a spotless kingdom called Duloc.
He tortured a gingerbread man, drove fairy-tale creatures out of their homes and sent someone else to rescue his bride.
Animated fairy tale comedy, 2001
A grumpy ogre agrees to rescue a princess from a dragon-guarded tower to get his swamp back.
My client lets fate decide. He even offered some of the people he met a fair coin toss.
A silent hitman with a strange haircut who carries a cattle gun.
He strangled a deputy with handcuffs and left a trail of bodies across Texas chasing a bag of money.
Neo-western crime thriller, 2007
A hunter who finds drug money in the Texas desert is pursued by a relentless killer while an aging sheriff follows.
My client is a misunderstood social thinker. He only wanted to show the city what its good citizens would do when pushed.
A scarred criminal in clown makeup who tells a different story every time about how he got his scars.
He blew up a hospital, burned a mountain of cash and rigged two ferries full of people with explosives.
Superhero crime thriller, 2008
A masked vigilante, a police lieutenant and a district attorney try to stop an anarchist who throws a city into chaos.
My client is the most popular girl in school who kindly welcomed a new student into her group of friends.
The queen bee of a clique called the Plastics.
She kept a book of cruel rumors about classmates and teachers and spread it across the whole school.
Teen comedy, 2004
A teenager raised in Africa starts at an American high school and gets caught up in its most popular clique.
My client is a fashion designer who made a generous offer to buy some puppies and was rudely turned away.
A wealthy socialite with half-black, half-white hair and a passion for fur coats.
She hired two thugs to steal fifteen puppies, bought eighty-four more, and planned to make them into a coat.
Animated family adventure, 1961
Two dogs rescue their stolen puppies, and dozens of others, from a woman who wants their spotted fur.
My client is a businesswoman who offered a fair contract, and the customer signed it willingly.
A sea witch with octopus tentacles and two pet eels.
She stole a young girl's voice, disguised herself to marry the girl's prince and tried to take over the ocean.
Animated musical, 1989
A mermaid princess trades her voice for human legs to win the heart of a prince.
My client is a brilliant psychiatrist who volunteered his time to help the FBI catch a serial killer.
A cultured doctor known for his fine taste in wine, his manners and his dinner guests.
He escaped custody by killing two guards and wearing one of their faces as a disguise.
Psychological horror thriller, 1991
A young FBI trainee seeks help from an imprisoned cannibal psychiatrist to catch another serial killer.
My client is a visionary who saw the universe running out of resources and made a hard choice to save it.
A purple titan collecting six powerful stones in a golden gauntlet.
He sacrificed his own daughter to get one of the stones, then wiped out half of all life with a snap of his fingers.
Superhero action, 2018
Earth's heroes and their allies join forces to stop a warlord from gathering six cosmic stones.
My client fell in love at first sight and kept a whole kingdom running while its queen ran away.
A charming prince, the youngest of thirteen brothers from the Southern Isles.
He refused a dying princess the kiss that could save her, left her to freeze and raised his sword at her sister.
Animated musical, 2013
A princess sets out to find her sister, whose ice powers have trapped their kingdom in an endless winter.
My client saved a man's life after a car crash in a blizzard and nursed him back to health in her own home. She is his number one fan.
A former nurse living alone in a remote farmhouse in Colorado.
She kept a famous author prisoner, forced him to rewrite his novel and broke his ankles with a sledgehammer.
Psychological thriller, 1990
A novelist injured in a crash is rescued by an obsessed fan who refuses to let him leave.
My client is a loving family who welcomed their daughter's boyfriend home for the weekend.
A wealthy suburban family led by a neurosurgeon and a hypnotherapist who stirs her tea.
They hypnotized a guest, auctioned him to their friends and planned to transplant someone else's brain into his body.
Social thriller horror, 2017
A young Black man visits his white girlfriend's family estate and uncovers a disturbing secret.
My client is a creative boy with an interest in engineering and recycling. He gives old toys a second life.
The neighbor kid who blows up and rebuilds toys, with a skull on his T-shirt.
He strapped a rocket to a space ranger toy and planned to launch it, and turned other toys into mutant creations.
Animated buddy comedy, 1995
A cowboy doll jealous of a new spaceman toy must team up with him to get home before their owner moves away.
My client gave his fiancee a priceless diamond, and she betrayed him with a penniless artist she met on the trip.
A rich, jealous steel heir engaged to a young woman from a struggling upper-class family.
He framed a man for theft, chased the couple through a sinking ship firing a pistol and used a lost child to get a seat on a lifeboat.
Romantic disaster epic, 1997
A wealthy young woman falls for a poor artist aboard a famous ocean liner on its doomed first voyage.
